verdict.rationale: Jira exposes a REST API and JQL that community members report using for scripted/automated interactions (e.g., writing API wrapper scripts, running REST queries), suggesting headless automation is possible, but there is no first-party documentation of CI-specific workflows, official CLI, or automation pipeline examples, and probes for OpenAPI/llms.txt discovery failed. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation docs, official CLI or SDK for pipelines, discoverable API spec (OpenAPI 404s).
